pairings.rationale: Mojo Rojo is another traditional Canarian sauce that complements the Original Mojo Verde beautifully, combining earthiness with its own spicy and smoky notes, enhancing grilled meats and vegetables.
The Vegetable and Beef Skillet can be elevated by drizzling Original Mojo Verde over it, as the zesty freshness of the sauce enhances the savory flavors of the dish.
Preserved Lemon Couscous offers a bright, citrusy contrast that pairs well with the fresh herbaceous notes of Original Mojo Verde, creating a vibrant and refreshing combination.
Cumin is a key ingredient in both Original Mojo Verde and many complex dishes, providing a warm, earthy base that complements the zesty profile of the sauce.
